drhp.business: The Company operates an integrated healthcare ecosystem combining clinic-based consultations and disease-reversal programmes, hospital-based inpatient and rehabilitation care, sale of proprietary Ayurvedic medicines, nutraceuticals and wellness products, franchise operations, corporate healthcare programmes and insurance-supported healthcare services. Its treatment focus is chronic lifestyle disorders such as coronary artery disease, diabetes, hypertension and obesity, delivered through structured, non-invasive, evidence-based Ayurvedic protocols under the Madhavbaug brand.

It continued to strengthen manufacturing capabilities through subsidiaries Dynamic Remedies Private Limited and UV Ayurgen Pharma Private Limited (backward integration for medicines, nutraceuticals and diet products). sk.overview: The DRHP frames the sector using the commissioned '1Lattice Report' (Molecular Diagnostics Industry Report dated July 24, 2026). Diagnostics is positioned as the cornerstone of India's healthcare sector, split into in vitro diagnostics (pathology tests on samples) and in vivo diagnostics (radiology). Within IVD, molecular diagnostics analyses nucleic acids (DNA/RNA) via PCR, isothermal amplification, nucleic acid hybridisation and microarrays to detect infectious disease, oncology and genetic conditions.
